classes.name: unkn0wn.ae.api.scripts.user.IScriptVectorAngle
classes.doc:
Interface representing a scripted vector angle.
 This interface defines methods for performing various operations on vector angles,
 including addition, subtraction, multiplication, length calculation, normalization, scalar and vector product, and others.

methods.name: toArrayString
methods.doc: Convert this vector angle to an array string

methods.name: add
methods.doc: Adds the current scripted vector angle to another scripted vector angle.

returns.doc: The new script vector angle that is the result of the addition.

arguments.name: other
arguments.doc: The other script vector angle to be folded.

methods.name: subtract
methods.doc: Subtracts another scripted vector angle from the current scripted vector angle.

returns.doc: The new script vector angle that is the result of the subtraction.

arguments.name: other
arguments.doc: Another script vector angle to subtract.

methods.name: multiply
methods.doc: Multiplies the current script vector angle by a scalar.

returns.doc: The new script vector angle that is the result of multiplying by the scalar.

arguments.name: scalar
arguments.doc: The scalar to multiply the scripted vector angle by.

methods.name: multiply
methods.doc: Calculates the vector product of the current script vector angle with another script vector angle.

returns.doc: The new scripted vector angle that is the result of the vector product.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.doc: The other script vector angle with which to calculate the vector product.

methods.name: length
methods.doc: Calculates the length of the current script vector angle.

returns.doc: The length of the scripted vector angle.

methods.name: normalize
methods.doc: Normalizes the current script vector angle.

returns.doc: New normalized script vector angle.

methods.name: dotProduct
methods.doc: Calculates the scalar product of the current script vector angle with another script vector angle.

returns.doc: Scalar product of script vector angles.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.doc: The other script vector angle with which to calculate the scalar product.

methods.name: crossProduct
methods.doc: Calculates the vector product of the current script vector angle with another script vector angle.

returns.doc: The new scripted vector angle that is the result of the vector product.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.doc: The other script vector angle with which to calculate the vector product.

methods.name: divide
methods.doc: Divides the current script vector angle by another script vector angle.

returns.doc: The new script vector angle that is the result of the division.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.doc: The other script vector angle to divide the current one by.

methods.name: copy
methods.doc: Creates a copy of the current scripted vector angle.

returns.doc: A new script vector angle that is a copy of the current one.

methods.name: equals
methods.doc: Checks if the current script vector angle is equal to another script vector angle.

returns.doc: true if the scripted vector angles are equal, otherwise false.

arguments.name: vector
arguments.doc: The other script vector angle to compare the current one to.

methods.name: equals
methods.doc: Checks if the current script vector angle is equal to the given angle and vector components.

returns.doc: true if the scripted vector angle is equal to the specified components, otherwise false.

arguments.name: angle
arguments.doc: Value of the angle.

arguments.name: x
arguments.doc: Value of the x-component of the vector.

arguments.name: y
arguments.doc: Value of the y component of the vector.

arguments.name: z
arguments.doc: Value of the z-component of the vector.

classes.name: unkn0wn.ae.api.scripts.user.IScriptMatrix
classes.doc:
Interface representing a script matrix.
 Defines methods for working with matrices, such as getting dimensions, accessing elements,
 creating a copy, smoothing, transposing and other operations.

methods.name: getRows
methods.doc: Returns the number of rows in the matrix.

returns.doc: the number of rows in the matrix

methods.name: getCols
methods.doc: Returns the number of columns in the matrix.

returns.doc: the number of columns in the matrix

methods.name: getValue
methods.doc: Returns the value of the matrix element by the given row and column indices.

returns.doc: value of matrix element by given indices

arguments.name: row
arguments.doc: row index

arguments.name: col
arguments.doc: column index

methods.doc: Sets the value of the matrix element by the given row and column indices.

arguments.name: row
arguments.doc: row index

arguments.name: col
arguments.doc: column index

arguments.name: value

returns.doc: true if the matrix contains elements within the given radius, otherwise false

arguments.name: x

arguments.name: y

arguments.name: r

methods.name: copy

arguments.name: a

arguments.doc: the second number

classes.name: unkn0wn.ae.api.scripts.user.renderer.Interpolation
classes.doc:
Interpolation is used in {@link IScriptCamera}, {@link IScriptHandRender} and {@link IScriptHudRender}.

Interpolation creates smooth movements via the Mclib's mod by McHorse.

{@code
     linear,

     quad_in,
     quad_out,
     quad_inout,

     cubic_in,
     cubic_out,
     cubic_inout,

     exp_in,
     exp_out,
     exp_inout,

     back_in,
     back_out,
     back_inout,

     elastic_in,
     elastic_out,
     elastic_inout,

     bounce_in,
     bounce_out,
     bounce_inout,

     sine_in,
     sine_out,
     sine_inout,

     quart_in,
     quart_out,
     quart_inout,

     quint_in,
     quint_out,
     quint_inout,

     circle_in,
     circle_out,
     circle_inout.
 }
